# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby was a handsome young woman with long yellow hair, bright-blue eyes, a brilliant complexion, and a plump, showy figure. Toward the end of her life, galloping consumption caused her to become very thin, leaving her cheeks hectically bright and her hands transparently delicate. Even in death, she was remembered as exceptionally beautiful.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P31](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0031)_

## Personality

Ruby was cheerful, good-tempered, and loved the pleasant things in life. She was quite sentimental in her early writings, though prone to hysterics when startled or frightened. She was obsessed with young men and flirtation, always seeking to gather as many suitors as possible.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

## History

Ruby grew up in Avonlea among a large family of sisters. In her schooldays at Avonlea School, she was part of the local girl circle, joining Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and Jane Andrews in school dialogues, concerts, and their creative Story Club. She later studied for the Entrance exams alongside her classmates and attended Queen's Academy to earn a teaching certificate. Upon completing her studies, she took a position as the schoolteacher at Carmody, though her primary focus remained on her numerous admirers and romantic prospects. During a visit to Boston, she began suffering health complications and contracted galloping consumption, forcing her to give up teaching in the winter. Despite her failing health, she remained hopeful about securing the White Sands school in the fall. She passed away peacefully in her sleep at her home in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 c11 P34](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0034), [v3 c11 P53](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0053), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)_
